session_summary: Evaluated the coin flow and marketplace purchasing behavior during a Treasure Run session. The player collected 5 initial coins, completed the route for a +25 coin bonus, and successfully purchased the Trail Cap (45 coins) and Moon Hood (80 coins), leaving 21 coins and failing to afford the elite Waypoint Crown. The current economy balances mid-tier spending well, but highlights a currency wall for elite cosmetics.

observations.evidence: After completing Treasure Run and gathering initial coins (totaling 146 gross coins acquired/managed), the player could buy two mid-tier items (Trail Cap at 45 and Moon Hood at 80) but was left with 21 coins, falling short of the elite item threshold ('waypoint_crown' returned 'Not enough coins').
observations.recommendation: Adjust elite cosmetic price points or scale route completion bonuses slightly to smooth out the progression curve between mid-tier and high-tier items.

observations.evidence: Marketplace feedback messages clearly state success ('Purchased and equipped...') and failure ('Not enough coins.'), providing immediate transactional clarity.
observations.recommendation: Maintain the clear purchase feedback messaging format across all future cosmetic additions.

feature_requests.title: Weekend Route Coin Multiplier Content Pack
feature_requests.player_value: Helps bridge the currency gap for high-end marketplace items without breaking core balance.
feature_requests.rationale: Players saving toward elite cosmetics like the Waypoint Crown experience a sharp drop-off in purchasing power after buying two mid-tier items.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce a temporary content modifier that grants a +10 coin bonus on alternate completion paths to accelerate elite item acquisition.

keep: Clear marketplace transaction error messages ('Not enough coins.')
Rewarding route completion bonuses that allow immediate early-game purchasing power
focus: coin flow, marketplace value, reward pacing, meaningful spending decisions
